soon_body: Right now we focus on the most important thing: speaking. This section will be added later.
hero_title: You understand German… but go quiet when it's time to speak?
hero_body: Many learners are great at grammar, reading and listening — but the job market needs someone who can actually talk to a German client or colleague. Here you speak out loud with a partner who talks exactly at your level, with no one judging you.
how_1_b: Four partners: A1, A2, B1, B2 — each one locked to its level.
how_2_b: Hold the mic and talk about anything. They talk less, you talk more.
how_3_b: Mistakes, pronunciation, vocabulary, homework — compared with last time.
group_basics_sub: The most important stage: build the foundation and get used to speaking without fear
group_build_sub: Develop your speaking and talk confidently about deeper topics and work
speak_sub: Choose the partner at your level. Each partner is not allowed to speak above its level.
unfinished_body: These sessions were closed before a report was created. You can create it now.

vid_nicos_intro: A free learning series by DW. It tells the story of Nico, who comes to Germany without speaking German and learns it step by step — with you.
vid_tip: Watch first without subtitles, then with German subtitles (CC), then repeat the sentences out loud (shadowing).
vid_talk_sub: Done? Tell your partner about what you watched — they ask at your level.
vid_vt_intro: Short DW reports about life in Germany at B2. Watch, read the text, then talk about the topic.

lvl_A1_desc: Everyday basics: introductions, family, food and drink, shopping, times and numbers, directions.
lvl_A2_desc: Your day and routine, travel and transport, simple work and study talk, the doctor and health, telling what happened (Perfekt).
lvl_B1_desc: Giving and defending your opinion, telling experiences, work and customers, phone calls, job interviews, problems and solutions.
ctopic_B1_smalltalk: Small talk in the office kitchen
lvl_B2_desc: Discussions and general topics: technology, society, culture, the economy, the news, professional topics — speaking fluently and debating.
lvl_B2_note: Close to fluent on general topics
